mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RECEIVE_AI_DATA ( input_dttm, analysis_id, schema_version, pet_id, video_id, camera_id, species, recorded_at, time_slot, analysis_status, activity_level, stationary_ratio, normalized_travel_distance, normalized_moving_speed, baseline_status, change_status, change_score ) VALUES ( #{recordedAt}, #{analysisId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{petId}, #{videoId}, #{cameraId}, #{species}, #{recordedAt}, #{timeSlot}, #{analysisStatus}, #{activityLevel}, #{stationaryRatio}, #{normalizedTravelDistance}, #{normalizedMovingSpeed}, #{baselineStatus}, #{changeStatus}, #{changeScore} )
mapper.select: SELECT input_dttm, analysis_id, schema_version, pet_id, video_id, camera_id, species, recorded_at, time_slot, analysis_status, activity_level, stationary_ratio, normalized_travel_distance, normalized_moving_speed, baseline_status, change_status, change_score FROM RECEIVE_AI_DATA ORDER BY input_dttm DESC LIMIT 1
